raw_html: [[Suppress Madness]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''Suppress Madness:''' This strange creature is enchanted with the ability to temporarily filter the maddening effects of certain Xoriat items. Wearing it will suppress the effects of the following: [[Curse Vector]], [[Unwieldy]], [[Overfocus]], [[Mind Turbulence]], [[Symbiotic Backlash]], [[Metal Fatigue]], [[Power Drain]], and [[Single-Mindedness]].
